name: GCP Incident Manager Agent
description: Google Cloud Incident Manager Agent for alert and incident triage, Cloud Logging root-cause correlation, Cloud Support case inspection, and official GCP remediation lookup.

skills.name: GCP Alert & Incident Triage
skills.description: Inspects active Cloud Monitoring alerts, alert policies, and time-series metrics to triage incidents.
examples: List all active alerts and alert policies in the project and summarize open incidents
Inspect alert details and metric time series for the firing incident

skills.name: Cloud Logging & Support Case Correlation
skills.description: Correlates Cloud Logging error/audit entries and Cloud Support cases/comments during incident investigation.
examples: Correlate recent severity>=ERROR logs with active alerts and check open Cloud Support cases

skills.name: GCP Troubleshooting & Remediation Lookup
skills.description: Searches official Google Cloud documentation for incident remediation guides and SRE best practices.
examples: Find official GCP troubleshooting steps for resolving this incident
